visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Count Letters Instead of Sorting
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Both words are bubble sorted and then compared. Replace the sorting with a letter-counting function. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Counting needs a single pass over each word, sorting needs nested loops and modifies the input. The counting version also works for words of different lengths, because leftover counts reveal the mismatch.
